associations.rationale: The linear equivalence with a left ideal is a later structural consequence and does not state any of the displayed projector formulas or their nonvanishing.
The named Young-projector definition directly formalizes the source's equation c_lambda = a_lambda b_lambda, so it is primary.
The named youngProjectorCol declaration directly formalizes the source's column-projector construction b_lambda, so it is primary.
Idempotence of the column projector is a consequence useful for the construction, but the source passage here defines the projectors and states nonvanishing rather than this equation.
The named youngProjectorRow declaration directly formalizes the source's row-projector construction a_lambda, so it is primary.
Idempotence of the row projector is supporting structural information, not one of the formulas or the nonzero conclusion displayed in the source.
The formal type directly states that the Young projector is nonzero for every partition, matching the source's final conclusion that c_lambda is nonzero.
